context: This evaluation assesses how effectively the engineer uses the make-read-only-util package to implement a mutation tracking system. The focus is exclusively on correct usage of the package's API, including the buildMakeReadOnly factory function, violation logging mechanism, and advanced features like class filtering and property descriptor handling.

checklist.name: Uses buildMakeReadOnly
checklist.description: Imports and calls buildMakeReadOnly from make-read-only-util package as the core implementation mechanism

checklist.name: Correct logger parameter
checklist.description: Passes a logger/handler function as the first parameter to buildMakeReadOnly that matches the ROViolationLogger type signature (violation, source, key, value?)

checklist.name: Class filtering parameter
checklist.description: Passes the excludedClasses/skippedClasses array as the second parameter to buildMakeReadOnly to enable class-based filtering

checklist.name: Returns makeReadOnly function
checklist.description: Correctly returns the function produced by buildMakeReadOnly, which takes a value and source string and returns the wrapped value

checklist.name: Maps violation types
checklist.description: Correctly maps the four package violation types (FORGET_MUTATE_IMMUT, FORGET_DELETE_PROP_IMMUT, FORGET_CHANGE_PROP_IMMUT, FORGET_ADD_PROP_IMMUT) to the spec's types (MUTATE, DELETE, CHANGE, ADD)

checklist.name: Handler integration
checklist.description: Integrates the custom ViolationHandler by wrapping it in the ROViolationLogger to properly forward violation events with correct parameters
